title: RuntimeDisclosureDecision.v1
description: WP12: the compiler's disclosure eligibility decision for one request, computed after config/trust resolution and before fleet/provider capability selection. Only a sensitive-signal boolean and reason codes are retained; matched request content is never stored on this record.

disclosureClass.description: LOCAL_ONLY never leaves the local compiler; INTERNAL_REDACTABLE may reach configured native capabilities; only EXTERNAL_ALLOWED may reach external-CLI/fleet capabilities.

predictionIdentity.description: Identity of whatever produced the request's task-family classification this decision rides alongside.

sensitiveSignalDetected.description: True iff any line of the request matched the credential-bearing pattern.

explicitFleetRoute.description: Mirrors WorkflowCompilerContext.fleetRoute === true; never inferred from classification.

projectTrustStatus.description: Resolved project-overlay trust used by disclosure classification.

reasonCodes.description: Non-empty, stable, uppercase reason codes explaining the disclosureClass decision.
